entries.question: delivery shipping time
entries.answer: The standard estimated delivery time shown by the catalogue is 7–10 days. Availability and final delivery terms must be confirmed before live sales are enabled.

entries.question: countries europe delivery
entries.answer: VERAPEP is configured for European markets only. Individual product and country availability is managed in the administration portal.

entries.question: price pricing vat shipping
entries.answer: Customer-facing EUR pricing is still under review. Product pages may show source-workbook USD reference data, but live checkout and purchasing remain disabled.

entries.question: lab report certificate coa
entries.answer: Lab reports can be linked to individual products from the administration portal. Only approved reports should be published.

entries.question: account login password my pages
entries.answer: The customer account area is available as a demonstration. Production identity, email verification and privacy configuration are required before launch.

entries.question: saved favourites favorite heart shortlist cart
entries.answer: Use the heart on a product card or product page to save it. Saved products are kept separately from the future shopping cart and appear under My Pages.

entries.question: find filter goal need skin weight recovery sleep focus product guide
entries.answer: Use the guided product finder to choose a broad interest, a more specific information area and optional priorities. The same filters are used by Ask Vera and the visible catalogue.

entries.question: rating ratings review reviews stars
entries.answer: Only admin-approved reviews appear publicly and affect product averages. Products without approved reviews show “No ratings yet”.
